summary.headline: Adds graceful HTTP server shutdown on SIGINT and SIGTERM signals
summary.description: This PR modifies the Express demo server to capture the return value of app.listen() and register process signal handlers for SIGINT and SIGTERM. When either signal is received, the server logs the signal, calls server.close() to stop accepting new connections and drain in-flight requests, then exits with code 0 once the server has fully closed.

changes.description: Store HTTP server instance and register graceful shutdown handlers

details.rationale: server.close() requires a reference to the HTTP server instance returned by app.listen()

details.added: for (const signal of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM']) { process.on(signal, () => { console.log(`${signal} received, shutting down`); server.close(() => process.exit(0)); }); }
details.rationale: SIGINT handles Ctrl+C during local development; SIGTERM is the standard signal sent by process managers and container orchestrators during restarts and deployments

behavioralImpact.before: The server process terminated immediately on SIGINT/SIGTERM without closing the HTTP server, potentially aborting in-flight requests.
behavioralImpact.after: On SIGINT or SIGTERM, the server stops accepting new connections, waits for existing requests to complete, then exits cleanly with status code 0.

risksAndLimitations.description: If in-flight requests hang indefinitely, server.close() will not invoke its callback and the process may not exit until forcibly killed.
server.close() stops new connections and waits for idle keep-alive connections; long-lived connections may delay shutdown.
If signal handlers were registered elsewhere, multiple handlers could fire; not applicable in the current single-file app.

testingRecommendations: Start the server with npm start and send SIGTERM (kill <pid>) — verify log output and clean exit
Start the server and press Ctrl+C (SIGINT) — verify same graceful shutdown behavior
Send a request to POST /echo while simultaneously signaling shutdown — verify the request completes before exit
Confirm the process exits with code 0 after shutdown
